faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.a1: PromptAI is a free AI-powered tool that analyzes your images and videos to generate professional prompts for AI engines like Midjourney, DALL-E, Runway, Sora, and Luma.
faq.q2: How many free attempts do I get?
faq.a2: You get 5 free attempts per day. You can earn 5 more by watching a short ad.
faq.a3: For images: JPG, PNG, GIF, WEBP. For videos: MP4, WEBM.
faq.a4: No. Your images and videos are processed in real-time and never stored on our servers.
faq.a5: We support Midjourney v6, DALL-E 3, Runway Gen-3, Sora, and Luma.
faq.q6: Can I use this on my phone?
faq.a6: Yes! PromptAI is a Progressive Web App (PWA) that works on any device and can be installed on your home screen.
